# Rathna Enterprises

Rathna Enterprises is a family-run electronics, furniture, home-appliance, mobile, household-goods, and gifting retailer in Madurantakam, Tamil Nadu. The business has served local families since 1981 and operates two branches.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.rathnaenterprises.com/): Business overview and contact information
- [Why Rathna](https://www.rathnaenterprises.com/#why-rathna): Reasons families choose Rathna
- [About](https://www.rathnaenterprises.com/#about): Company history and three-generation timeline
- [Products](https://www.rathnaenterprises.com/#products): Product categories available in store
- [Partnered brands](https://www.rathnaenterprises.com/#brands): Major electronics and appliance brands
- [Blogs](https://www.rathnaenterprises.com/#blogs): Buying guides, product-care advice, and store updates
- [Branches](https://www.rathnaenterprises.com/#branches): Branch information and directions
- [Contact](https://www.rathnaenterprises.com/#contact): Telephone, email, and address

## Notes for agents

- Product, model, and brand availability can vary by branch.
- Contact the store to confirm current stock, pricing, warranty terms, or directions.
- The public website is informational and does not provide online checkout.
